name: Lattice paths
formula: \#\text{paths from } (0,0) \text{ to } (m,n) \text{ with unit steps right and up} = \binom{m+n}{m}
whenToUse: Counting shortest routes on a grid, or any sequence made of a fixed number of two kinds of steps.
example: From $(0,0)$ to $(5,3)$ there are $\binom{8}{3} = 56$ paths. Those through $(2,1)$ number $\binom{3}{1} \cdot \binom{5}{2} = 3 \cdot 10 = 30$.
pitfall: To pass through a point, MULTIPLY the two leg counts. To avoid a point, subtract the paths through it from the total.
